findings.problem: This is a third copy of a nontrivial proof about naturality of the canonical iso F(A ⊞ B) ≅ X ⊞ Y. The proof uses `biprod.hom_ext`, then a `simp only` set (map_fst/snd, lift_fst/snd_assoc) and a `rw` chain that turns the component squares into `F.map (biprod.map ..) ≫ ..`. The same statement and proof exist as `LittleFinitistic.BiprodEvaluationSquare.square` and as `LittleFinitistic.DefaultSupport.biprod_square`. The three proofs are identical up to hypothesis names. This copy is private, so it cannot be shared. Any fix or simp-set change must be made in three places.
findings.proposed_change: Delete the private `mapBiprod_square` (lines 11-28). Keep one public general lemma, preferably the existing `BiprodEvaluationSquare.square`, whose hypotheses are only `Preadditive`, `HasBinaryBiproducts`, `F.Additive` and `PreservesBinaryBiproducts`. `BiprodEvaluationSquare.lean` imports only `FormalSummandAction`, which imports `OddDouble`, so importing it here creates no cycle. Keep `OddDouble` and `FormalSummandAction` out of the dependency if desired by moving `square` to a small file that imports only Mathlib. Then import it here and change the use at line 58 to `BiprodEvaluationSquare.square (completedDerivedEvaluation X) _ _ (completedSummandImageIso X e he) (completedShiftedSummandImageIso X e he n) _ _ (completed_corner_square X e a he) (completed_shifted_corner_square X e a he n)`. The argument order of `square` is f g i j f' g' hf hg, so it differs from the private lemma. Then rewrite `DiagramMaps.biprod_square` as a call to the same lemma, or remove it. `SourceOddDoubleEvaluation.lean` already uses `BiprodEvaluationSquare.square` the same way (line 63).
findings.benefit: One proof of the biproduct-square fact replaces three. A change to the simp set or to Mathlib's biproduct lemma names is made once. The target file shrinks to the odd-double definitions and the one-line square theorem, so the odd-double evaluation files treat the square the same way.
